title: Lockstep capture of a live run
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $D$ be a four-work-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet with finite state set and decidable state equality, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. If $M$ is not halted after any $s<t$ steps from $c$, then after $t$ steps the capture wrapper of $M$ and $D$, started from the first-phase configuration associated to $c$, is the first-phase configuration associated to the configuration reached by $M$ after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet
$D$ is a four-work-tape Boolean machine with finite state set and decidable state equality
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on the finite Boolean input $x$
For every natural number $s<t$, the configuration reached from $c$ after $s$ steps is not halted
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine $M$ on input $x$ and let $t$ be a
natural number such that $M$ has not halted after any $s < t$ steps from $c$.
Then $t$ transitions of the output-capture wrapper of $M$ and a four-tape
interpreter $D$, started from the first-phase embedding of $c$, produce
exactly the first-phase embedding of the configuration of $M$ after $t$
steps from $c$.
